title: Combustion air supply.
officialText:
The requirements of the New York City Energy Conservation Code concerning combustion air supply
shall be followed.
SECTION FGC 606
RESERVED
SECTION FGC 607
COMMERCIAL-INDUSTRIAL INCINERATORS
AND CREMATORIES
